name: Woodlouse

clues.plant:ink-cap: Tiny tracks wander between the Ink Caps, which have been nibbled at the edges.
clues.time: The tracks are fresh by day, in the damp shade under the leaves.

text: A small grey woodlouse that loves damp soil and mushroom gills. It rolls into a ball when surprised.

name: Cave Salamander

clues.plant:velvet-shank: A pale, damp trail winds through the Velvet Shanks.
clues.plant:ink-cap: The trail curls round the Ink Caps too, as if it's looking for something.
clues.time: The trail is only ever fresh after dark.

text: A pale, damp-skinned salamander that shelters among fungal roots and soft soil.

name: Firefly

clues.plant:foxfire-button: The Foxfire Buttons flicker as if something just rose from them.
clues.time: The flickering starts as the light goes, at dusk.

text: A glowing beetle that drifts over warm, sheltered plants at dusk.

name: Glowmoth

clues.plant:lantern-flower: Glowing dust lies on the Lantern Flowers.
clues.plant:honey-mushroom: A little of the same dust has settled on the Honey Mushrooms.
clues.time: The dust is only fresh after dark.

text: A soft-winged moth with luminous markings that pulse in the dark.

name: Bumblebee

clues.plant:marigold: Pollen-dusted footprints wander over the Marigolds.
clues.plant:cornflower: The Cornflowers are dusted with pollen too.
clues.time: There's a busy hum here in the middle of the day.

text: A fuzzy, round bumblebee, drawn to bright, nectar-rich flowers.

name: Ruby-throated Hummingbird

clues.plant:lavender: The Lavender has been sipped from, one tiny flower at a time.
clues.time: Something was here early, just as the light came.

text: A hovering nectar-feeder with a ruby throat. It loves tubular, brightly coloured flowers.

name: Mossback Hare

clues.plant:wood-sorrel: Little paths are pressed through the Wood Sorrel.
clues.time: The paths are fresh at dawn, still wet with dew.

text: A small hare with mossy fur and leaf-like tufts that blends into dense greenery.

name: Red Squirrel

clues.plant:hosta: Nibbled husks lie under the Hosta leaves.
clues.plant:wood-sorrel: A few more husks are tucked into the Wood Sorrel.
clues.time: Something rustles here in the daytime.

text: A nimble red squirrel, drawn to leafy, seed-rich corners of a garden.

name: Glasswing Butterfly

clues.plant:jewelweed: A wing-scale like a sliver of glass lies on a Jewelweed.
clues.time: It catches the light in the middle of the day.

text: A butterfly with clear wings, made for bright, shimmering clearings.

name: Prism Moth

clues.plant:glassbell: Tiny rainbow flecks dust the Glassbells.
clues.plant:jewelweed: A few rainbow flecks have landed on the Jewelweed too.

text: A moth with reflective scales that flash different colours as it turns.

name: Will-o'-Wisp Fox

clues.plant:wisp-cap: Faintly glowing pawprints circle the Wisp Caps.
clues.time: The pawprints are fresh at dawn, and fade as the sun comes up.

text: A fox-like spirit with faintly glowing paws that wanders where the mist is thickest.

name: Barn Owl

clues.plant:mistbell: A soft, pale feather rests among the Mistbells.
clues.plant:wisp-cap: Another feather lies by the Wisp Caps.
clues.time: It's only ever here in the deep of the night.

text: A quiet, pale hunter that loves silent, misty gardens at night.
